list.empty: No service accounts yet. The open API is only callable with a service-account key — create one, then issue a key.
list.noKeyTip: No valid key — every call is rejected
list.ownerDisabledTip: The resource owner is disabled; the account and its keys still work — disable or delete the account to revoke access
list.idleTip: No call in over {{days}} days — consider disabling it

create.title: New service account
create.resourceOwnerPlaceholderTenant: Pick a member of this tenant
create.resourceOwnerTip: Knowledge bases and other resources this integration creates belong to this person, who manages them inside the platform.
create.resourceOwnerOpenPlatformTip: Apps this account first deploys take this person as owner; only the owner can delete them or withdraw an approval request — an admin cannot act on their behalf. Ownership is fixed at creation time and changing the owner does not apply retroactively.
create.tenantFixedTip: The service account joins the tenant its resource owner belongs to, and cannot be moved afterwards.
create.success: Service account created — issue its first key now

detail.grantsPlaceholder: Resource-grant management ships in a later version.
detail.grantsEmptyHint: With no grants at all, every open-API call failing is the correct behaviour — grant the resources the integration needs explicitly here.

overview.ownerNotRetroactive: Changing the owner leaves already-created resources untouched; resources created afterwards belong to the new owner.
overview.disableConfirmDesc: Within 5 seconds its keys stop being accepted. Grants and configuration are kept, and re-enabling restores everything as it was.
overview.enableConfirmDesc: Its keys that are neither revoked nor expired become usable again immediately.
overview.deleteConfirmDesc: Deleting revokes the grants listed above; integrations depending on it fail immediately. The granted resources themselves and their owners are unaffected.
overview.deleteGrantsTitle: Resource grants this account currently holds:
overview.deleteGrantsEmpty: This account currently holds no resource grants.

keys.empty: No keys yet. Issue one to start calling the open API.
keys.revokeConfirmDesc: Within 5 seconds calls using this key are rejected. This cannot be undone.
keys.revokeConfirmOpenPlatformDesc: MCP, the model protocol surface and the CLI are all rejected at the same time.
keys.revokeAllConfirmTitle: Revoke every key of this account?
keys.revokeAllConfirmDesc: Every still-valid key of this account is invalidated immediately; integrations depending on them fail at once.

issueDialog.scopesDefaultHint: Nothing is checked by default; any scope left unchecked counts as not granted.
issueDialog.openApiSoftHint: For a key handed to an individual, granting only the local dev toolkit scopes is recommended.

reveal.title: Your new key
reveal.onceOnlyTip: This is the only time the key is shown in full. After you close this dialog it can never be viewed again — only the masked form is displayed.

workflow_invoke.label: Invoke workflows

assistant_invoke.label: Invoke assistants
assistant_invoke.desc: Chat with assistants and use the speech-to-text / text-to-speech endpoints.

assistant_read.label: Read assistants
assistant_read.desc: List assistants and read their details.

chat_invoke.label: Invoke chat
chat_invoke.desc: Start chat calls in daily-conversation mode.
chat_invoke.pending_note: Endpoints open in a later version

knowledge_read.label: Read knowledge
knowledge_read.desc: List knowledge bases and files, run retrieval, read QA pairs and citations.

knowledge_write.label: Write knowledge
knowledge_write.desc: Create, modify and delete knowledge bases, files, chunks, QA pairs and metadata.

model_invoke.label: Invoke platform models
model_invoke.desc: Call the platform's configured models through the model protocol surface.

identity_read.label: Read organization identity
identity_read.desc: Read the organization's users and departments so an app can resolve people and org units.
identity_read.full_org_warning: Checking this makes the entire org structure readable — it cannot be narrowed to selected departments

app_manage.label: Manage hosted apps
app_manage.desc: Create, deploy and manage hosted apps from the command line.
